critic_dispositions.note: Added a three-model access comparison with attribution, offboarding, offline-copy and fee tradeoffs.
Added cross-shift boundary, late arrivals and task/location/issue distinctions plus two-shift scenario.
Photo transforms, Wi-Fi default and deletion choices explicitly remain proposed and platform/policy dependent.
Queue order is per client; canonical claims, dedupe and current authorization remain app contracts.
Later assignments clear the current conflict view; app event history is separate.
Replicated branches differ from single-node 409; members are database-wide.
PostgreSQL guard is conditioned on schema/index/transaction; offline fairness is separate.
Storage can fail/evict; no post-eviction durability is promised.
At-access reporter caveats are appropriate, but S19 omits the existing explicit fix/version closure.

preservation.record_integrity: All three full embedded source registers equal predecessors; 31 inherited records are retained.
preservation.semantic_review: Independently traced workflows, hard negatives, current authorization, duplicate/backup cases, alternative tradeoffs, photo/cache/backup limitations, open decisions and proposed validation. Record equality was corroboration, not semantic proof.

excluded_or_unassessed.reason: Proposal deliverable; no execution required or performed.

finite_scope: COMPLETE means each required obligation/axis was assessed in the declared material domain, not every upstream file, all product mechanisms, or universal correctness. Supplemental failed current-core locators are explicit and do not certify that separate domain.
